messages:
Ravi Menon: FYI — Highland renewal coming up 7/31. Procurement surfaced a request: swap a 10% invoice discount for an "enablement stipend" (up to 10 seats + onboarding hours). They argue adoption shortfall.
Mia Chen: Adoption context: account health score dropped to 68. SSO mapping delay + missing CSV import blocking rollout. Customer asked for tangible help vs. pure dollar credit.
Lena Ortiz: Can we offer a 10-seat enablement stipend (up to 12 hours of services + 2 admin hours for seat provisioning) applied as an invoice credit, contingent on delivery & sign-off? They want it reflected on the renewal invoice, not a separate bill.
AJ Patel: Finance: moving a services credit onto the invoice is OK if we include a "Delivery & Acceptance" milestone and ensure there's no future refund liability. Also need a clause for minimum committed ARR for the extension.
Ravi Menon: Procurement also asks for a 3-month free pilot extension instead of stipend if product can't ship CSV import before renewal. They see extension as lower risk.
Mia Chen: Product update: CSV seat-mapping import estimated 3 weeks L0 + 1 week QA. If we expedite, delivery by 7/10 is feasible. That would likely resolve adoption and avoid extension demand.
Lena Ortiz: Operationally we need PO number to book services. ops-bot: please confirm we can accept PO on same invoice and apply credit after acceptance checklist.
ops-bot: Confirmed. We require PO matching invoice line item and signed acceptance checklist before applying credit.
Ravi Menon: Legal: do we need explicit consent for recorded enablement sessions and potential access to sample customer data for demo? @legal-bot
legal-bot: Yes — recordings and demo data exposure need a short addendum. I'll prepare a "Training Recording & Data Use" paragraph and a one-paragraph "Services Credit Acceptance" clause. ETA 6 hours.
AJ Patel: Also flagging revenue recognition: if we extend term + apply credit, we need an "anti-churn" clause or minimum spend to avoid deferring revenue. I'll propose a 6-mo extension with a 25% of renewal as committed spend.
Mia Chen: Counterproposal to procurement: (A) Ship CSV import by 7/10 + apply enablement stipend as invoice credit upon acceptance OR (B) 3-mo pilot extension with prorated seats and no stipend. Which does procurement prefer?
Ravi Menon: Procurement prefers A if product can commit to dates. They asked for trainer dates to be tentatively scheduled.
Lena Ortiz: I'll draft amendment language with: stipend scope, deliverables (recording, attendee list, acceptance checklist), PO requirement, and trainer tentative dates. Share for legal and finance review.
Mia Chen: Great — I'll hold sending countersign until legal addendum + finance commit language is in. Ravi — can you get procurement to confirm preferred path by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
